# Feature: index.css Design-System Refactor & Inline-Style Removal

## Overview
`client/src/index.css` has grown to **1225 lines** with duplicated radii, gaps, z-index literals, shadow definitions, and repeated utility patterns (flex rows, tag pills, overlay base). Five inline `style={{...}}` sites remain in `client/src/components/KanbanColumn.jsx:34`, `client/src/components/TaskCard.jsx:60,64,76`, and `client/src/components/OfflineBanner.jsx:37`, bypassing the design system and breaking Dark/Light consistency. This feature shortens `index.css` by consolidating tokens into reusable CSS variables (spacing, radius, font-size, z-index scales) and a shared overlay/button base, extracting all inline styles into semantic classes, and deduplicating repeated blocks (modal vs confirm overlay, offline banners, stat pills). No visual regression; the rendered board, modals, and banners must look identical while the stylesheet loses ≥15% line count.

## User Stories
- **As a developer**, I want spacing, radii, z-index, and shadow tokens centralized as CSS variables so adding a new component does not copy-paste `0.5rem` / `8px` / `z-index: 1000` literals.
- **As a developer**, I want zero inline `style=` in JSX so themes, responsiveness, and dark-mode overrides apply predictably through CSS alone.
- **As a reviewer**, I want `index.css` measurably shorter and less repetitive (deduplicated overlay, button, and tag rules) without changing the look and feel.

## Implementation Plan

No new visual components; refactor existing ones:

### Data Model (Mock)
No data model. Visual invariant: before/after screenshots are pixel-identical (board, board-stats, kanban columns, task cards, modals, confirm dialog, offline banners, project dropdown). Token mapping example:
```js
// before (hardcoded)
".navbar { z-index: 100 }"
".modal-overlay { z-index: 1000 }"
".confirm-overlay { z-index: 1100 }"

// after (tokenized)
":root { --z-navbar:100; --z-modal:1000; --z-confirm:1100 }"
".navbar { z-index: var(--z-navbar) }"
".modal-overlay { z-index: var(--z-modal) }"
".confirm-overlay { z-index: var(--z-confirm) }"

// before (inline)
"<span style={{ backgroundColor: column.color }} />"

// after (class)
"<span className=\"column-dot\" style={{ \"--dot-color\": column.color }} /> + CSS: .column-dot{ background: var(--dot-color) }"
// or fully class-based if color mapped to CSS via data attribute
```

### Simulated Backend
No backend change. This is a stylesheet/components refactor only; no API contract affected.

1. **Audit baseline**: Record `wc -l client/src/index.css` (1225), `Select-String -Pattern "style=" -Path client/src/**/*.jsx` (5 hits across 3 files), and count of `z-index:` literals (`Select-String -Pattern "z-index" -Path client/src/index.css` — currently 5 distinct values: 100,150,200,1000,1100) plus `border-radius:` unique values and `gap:` unique values. Snapshot before screenshots or note expected unchanged visuals.
2. **Design tokens**: At top of `client/src/index.css:3` inside `:root`, add grouped comment blocks `/* Spacing */`, `/* Radius */`, `/* Z-index */`, `/* Transitions */` and define the variables listed above. Mirror only theme-specific colors in `[data-theme="dark"]`; spacing/radius/z tokens stay in `:root` only (shared).
3. **Token replacement pass** (search-replace, keep tabs/CRLF):
   - Replace each literal `z-index: 100` → `z-index: var(--z-navbar)`, `150` → `var(--z-banner)`, `200` → `var(--z-dropdown)`, `1000` → `var(--z-modal)`, `1100` → `var(--z-confirm)`.

   - Replace each literal `border-radius: 6px`→`var(--radius-sm)`, `8px`→`var(--radius-md)`, `10px`→`var(--radius-lg)`, `12px`→`var(--radius-xl)`, `16px`→`var(--radius-2xl)`, `999px`→`var(--radius-pill)`.

4. **Eliminate inline styles in JSX**:

Implementation: `<span className="column-dot" style={{ "--dot-color": column.color } as React.CSSProperties} />` and add to `index.css` near `.column-dot:694`: `.column-dot { background-color: var(--dot-color, var(--status-todo)); }`. ## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `client/src/index.css` defines and uses centralized CSS variables for spacing (`--space-*`), radius (`--radius-*`), and z-index (`--z-*`) — at least 5 of each token type actually consumed in the sheet.
- [ ] Scattered literals replaced: no remaining hardcoded `z-index: 100/150/200/1000/1100`, `border-radius: 6/8/10/12/16px`, or duplicated overlay declarations — verified by grep that overlay base is grouped and z-index uses `var(--z-...)`.
- [ ] `.offline-banner-offline` and `.offline-banner-pending` deduplicated (grouped selector or shared base) — only one rule block for the amber banner styling.
- [ ] Inline `style=` removed from `client/src/components/TaskCard.jsx:60,64,76` and `client/src/components/OfflineBanner.jsx:37` (replaced by classes); `client/src/components/KanbanColumn.jsx:34` no longer uses `style={{ backgroundColor: ... }}` — uses CSS variable forwarding or class-based color (one `style={{ "--dot-color": ... }}` forwarding is acceptable and documented).
- [ ] `Select-String -Pattern "style=" -Path client/src/**/*.jsx` returns zero hits (or exactly 1 documented `--dot-color` forwarding hit).
- [ ] `client/src/index.css` is measurably shorter — line count reduced by ≥10% (target ≥15%, e.g., 1225 → ≤1040) or reviewer confirms substantial deduplication of repeated blocks.
- [ ] No visual regression across Light/Dark themes, modals, confirm dialog stacking, and offline banners; `pnpm check` and `pnpm build` pass.
- [ ] Feature is independent — no edits to `apiClient.js` or docs paths required to land.
